catalog.title: Seiko JDM Catalog No.2 Supplement
catalog.note: Japanese domestic catalogue セイコーウオッチカタログ '68/no.2 増補版 (supplement), 31 scan pages: cover, contents, catalogue pages printed 1–27 (men's, ladies' and stopwatches), a blank MEMO page and the back cover. Each watch is printed as ◇symbol + model number with a (case–dial) code, e.g. ◇45GSC 010 (800-800); ref = symbol-number in the site's JDM hyphen style (45GSC-010, 61-5D-160, ladies' 10S-A-664 for ◇10S A664), code = the printed line, caseDialCode = the bracketed code. A second number marked 〃 和 is the same watch with the day in Japanese and is kept in code/notes, not as a separate record. Jewels (石) are printed with each model name except on Grand Seiko and King Seiko. Prices are list prices in yen per printed material/band line (SS stainless, GC gold cap, SGP gold-plated, ASGP A-grade gold-plated, WGP white-gold-plated, PDP palladium-plated, 14K·WG / 18K solid gold, SILVER, ACRP A-grade chrome-plated; WP water-proof; MB metal bracelet, LB leather band — no bracelet part codes are printed). (近日発売) = coming soon. No case-movement (CCCC-NNNN) refs are printed; caliber is filled only where the symbol is the movement number (2559, 6117), family symbols (45GSC, 56LMW, 61-5D …) are left blank. Dial colours are read from the photos. The twin scan '1968 Seiko V2.pdf' was compared page for page: same 31 pages, same image sizes and text layer, renders identical within JPEG noise (it is a more heavily compressed copy); its page 29 is the same blank MEMO page, so nothing was taken from it.
catalog.method: Vision transcription of the 250 DPI renders (Oct 2026), every caption verified against full-resolution caption crops; the PDF text layer (OCR) was used only as a cross-check.
